Licorice Root (DGL)

Remedy licorice dgl gut-health adrenal anti-inflammatory

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Deglycyrrhizinated licorice for gut healing and adrenal support without blood pressure effects.

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Adrenal Fatigue
    Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis dysfunction leading to chronic fatigue and stress intolerance.
  • Histamine Intolerance
    Inability to properly break down histamine leading to allergy-like symptoms.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Menopause Transition
    Hormonal changes during the menopausal transition causing various symptoms.
  • Osteoporosis
    A condition that weakens bones, making them fragile and more likely to break.
  • Gut Dysbiosis
    Imbalance of beneficial gut bacteria leading to digestive issues and compromised immunity.
